_meta.description: Compose batch of two crosstab slots (total_pop, audience_a) over region x segment decorated with an OVERLAY_DELTA_VS_REF matrix-shape compose overlay that emits (audience_a_cell - total_pop_cell) per cell. Subtractive twin of OVERLAY_INDEX_VS_REF (12_compose_audience_index_vs_total.json) — same alignment + schema-match contract, additive arithmetic instead of ratio. DELTA preserves cell units (counts) so renderers surface absolute audience uplift / shortfall against the population baseline. Reference names the baseline slot; Targets names the slot whose cells the overlay decorates. Mathematically defined for every finite reference value including zero (the handler does NOT emit PULSE_OVERLAY_REF_ZERO on zero ref cells — subtraction is well-defined). Buffered (Compose slot barrier — MATRIX arm). Renderers centre diverging colour ramps on baseline = 0.
_meta.name: compose-delta-vs-ref
